title: Three Brillhart-Lehmer-Selfridge primality proofs for Wagstaff numbers
description:
BLS N-1 primality certificates for the Wagstaff numbers W_2617 (788 digits), W_10501 (3161 digits), and W_12391 (3730 digits), together with the drivers that produced them and an independent re-verifier.

All cofactors of N-1 are certified by APR-CL (PARI/GP isprime(x, 2)). As an independent sanity check, the Chua congruence omega_3^((N+1)/2) = -1 (mod N) is verified at each W_p in Z[sqrt 2] / (N). The method does not depend on the Chebyshev sufficiency conjecture.

Contents: paper/ manuscript sources (LaTeX); scripts/ primality drivers and verify_bls.py; data/ JSON certificates; logs/ full stdout of the cluster runs that produced the two larger certificates.

Code and certificates are released under MIT; the manuscript under paper/ is released under CC-BY-4.0 (see LICENSE-PAPER).
